text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while out with Sakura Laurel—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking where Sakura Laurel is pointing,
I see a crane game filled with plushies
modeled after Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
It really captures everyone's features well, doesn't it!
I'd love to display it in my room~.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, but I might not have
much cash on me today.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: You will, Trainer? Are you sure?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. In that case, maybe I'll look forward to seeing
what you can do, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
